# Runbook

Load `skills/ops-runbook-authoring/SKILL.md`.

Write one command, the output that means it worked, and who to call when that output does not appear. Point at the rollback in `skills/ops-rollback-plan/SKILL.md` when the step can change production. Do not put a secret value in the runbook.
